text:
maria: thinking about adding a per-session token burn heatmap to the cost dashboard. shows token burn over session timeline, cache refunds, and model-switch events. would help devs debug spikes from fallback routing. any concerns about perf or privacy?
ben: love it. main concern: high-cardinality if we show session ids. maybe sample or aggregate by user_id hash. :thinking:
ankur: agree. also we need to decide attribution: attribute cache savings to route that created prefix vs route that consumed it. current chargeback ties to consumer which inflates tenant savings.
jules-devex: from UX, customers want a "what-if" slider: show costs if cache hit rate=50/75/90%. can we add simulated overlays?
ops-bot: note: telemetry payload for sessionization is ~3KB extra per request if we send full event stream. might add ~20% to ingestion costs.
liz: alternative: emit session start/stop + model-switch + token-aggregate events only. reconstruct token burn server-side to avoid payload bloat.
sam: for rollouts UX: when canary routes use fallback, surface "canary incurred X tokens via fallback" to PMs/SEs. currently hidden and causes surprise spikes.
ryan: internal API debate: do we expose raw token counts in the frontend? legal flagged potential PII risk if prompts are visible in drilldowns. we can expose counts and deltas but not raw text or full prompts.
billing-bot: FYI test env will not be billed; make sure to mark sample=true on telemetry events to avoid skewing production metrics.
ben: quick sketch for attribution query (pseudo SQL):
```
select session_hash, model_variant, sum(tokens) as total_tokens, sum(case when cache_hit then -cache_credit else tokens end) as net_tokens
from token_events
where ts between '{{start}}' and '{{end}}'
group by session_hash, model_variant
```
ankur: two additional notes: (1) sticky-routing amortization — if route A primed a prefix and route B consumed it, split savings proportional to first-touch token footprint or TTL overlap; (2) backfill behavior for cached prefixes during rollouts needs a deterministic rule.
jules-devex: mockups incoming. i'd like an initial compact heatmap tile + expand to session timeline + per-model legend. also "simulate cache hit" toggle.
maria: action items: (1) decide sampling vs full for prod telemetry (ben + ops), (2) settle attribution rule (ankur + billing), (3) add canary fallback metric to rollout dashboards (sam + ryan), (4) UX mockups and spec (jules). i'll open tickets. :+1:
deploy-bot: ticket 5462 created by maria: "sessionized token burn heatmap — spec"
ben: small note: heatmap needs to respect quota IDs and billing units so finance can map to chargeback.
maria: noted. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
